display.title: Episode 281: Torah, the Best Thing of All, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's start-of-summer show: using vacation to discover Hashem's world, Shema with a visiting family, and how Rabbi Akiva's treasure survived a pirate attack.
display.summary_long: Broadcast as summer vacation was about to begin. Uncle Yossi teaches that summer is a chance to get to know Hashem through the wonders of nature, and that three daily mitzvos, Torah, davening and tzedakah, bring a safe and healthy summer. He announces a phone line that helps families choose a truly Jewish day camp or overnight camp. After the Hakochainik march, story time recaps how Rabbi Akiva told the merchants on his ship that he carried a treasure worth more than gold. A visiting family of children says the Shema in Studio 604 and thanks their schools. In the conclusion of the story, pirates rob the ship, but Rabbi Akiva stays calm: his Torah cannot be taken away, and the merchants ask him to be their teacher. Mitzvah Time continues the laws of Havdalah, explaining the besamim, with a phone quiz for a listener who wins a Havdalah candle. The show ends with a birthday wish, Shabbos candle time and Shabbos Rosh Chodesh Tammuz.
display.lesson: Torah is the one treasure no one can take away from you; fill every day, even on vacation, with Torah, davening and tzedakah.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: candle time for Friday June 26 and 'this Shabbos is Shabbos Rosh Chodesh Tammuz'.
